about: The 7-Zip build whose 7z.dll goes into CUSTOS: the x64 installer for the standard edition, the 32-bit one (installer32) for the legacy edition (build.ps1 -Legacy). build.ps1 downloads these exact files and refuses them if a SHA-256 differs. To move to a new 7-Zip: change all seven values (the checksums are the 'digest' of each asset on https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases).
